multisig.note: Single-key accounts only; account import takes one xpub or a wpkh/sh(wpkh) descriptor; no m-of-n or MuSig2 code in the app

hw_signer.note: Imports signer xpub and fingerprint by QR (BC-UR, JSON export) and signs by PSBT QR; no named-device pairing; labelled experimental

psbt.note: Unsigned PSBT shown as animated QR (BC-UR, BBQr) or copied; signed PSBT scanned back and broadcast; for imported accounts only

watch_only.note: Imports an xpub or wpkh/sh(wpkh) descriptor as a watch-only LND account with its own balance; embedded LND rescans from a chosen height

passphrase.note: initWallet accepts a passphrase argument but no create or restore screen collects one; same for LDK Node

coin_control.note: On-chain Send has a UTXO picker to tick coins; each account also has a Coins list; LDK Node has it too

fee_bump.note: Speed up button on unconfirmed txs calls LND BumpFee on a wallet output (CPFP); LDK Node has no bump

taproot.note: Receive settings offer Taproot (P2TR) beside P2WPKH and nested SegWit; P2WPKH is the default; LDK Node issues P2WPKH only

descriptors.note: Imports single-key wpkh() and sh(wpkh()) descriptors as an account; no descriptor export; no tr(), pkh or multi-key forms

own_server.note: Add Neutrino peers by host and switch on 'don't allow other peers' to use only yours; LDK Node takes a custom Esplora URL

verifies_chain.note: Embedded LND runs Neutrino: headers and BIP 157/158 filters checked on the phone; LDK Node and remote nodes trust Esplora or the node

tor.note: No Tor toggle for the embedded node (embeddedTor stays false); the built-in Tor client is offered only for remote nodes

seed_standard.note: Embedded LND shows a 24-word aezeed (LND format, not BIP 39); the LDK Node option shows a BIP 39 phrase

cloud_backup.note: Embedded LND uploads only encrypted channel state to Olympus, no on-chain data or keys; LDK Node keeps node state on a VSS server
